attempt_definition: One call into the composed GPU consumer's accept (a composed game tick or a direct RenderInputConsumer::accept) or into RetainedScene::submit, including refusals that never reach the queue. Readback copies and the test-owned backlog copy submissions are not frames; they are recorded in the event logs.

regression_suites.gpu_host-lib: incant_render_gpu_host library unit tests (CPU mailbox tests; listed, no ignored cases expected)

cases.name: fixed_scales_ui_offset_viewport
cases.route: composed game with UI (disabled, fixed 16/12/8) plus two disabled RetainedScene references at the internal sizes

cases.name: fixed_scales_reference_recheck
cases.route: two disabled RetainedScene references at the internal sizes, compared with the appearance run's retained PNGs whose RGBA hashes equal run 1's disabled/12/8 receipts; UI boxes in physical pixels

cases.name: adaptive_paced_explicit_dispatch
cases.route: composed game with UI, realistic adaptive policy, one explicit blocking poll after every tick
injections: explicit test polls after each tick

cases.name: adaptive_natural_cadence
cases.route: composed game with UI, realistic adaptive policy, back-to-back ticks, host polls only

cases.name: delayed_delivery_resize_and_replacement
cases.route: composed game, stepping policy, viewport resize then script despawn (scene replacement)
injections: acquire-time blocking poll in ticks 2 and 5
explicit test polls after ticks 3 and 6

cases.name: drop_and_recreate_host
cases.route: two composed games sharing one renderer; the first dropped with work outstanding
injections: acquire-time blocking poll in B tick 1

cases.name: terminal_failures_and_late_callbacks
cases.route: direct GpuRenderConsumer accept (RenderInputConsumer) with SceneInput from the CPU observer game
injections: queue backlog before each first frame

cases.name: owner_contract_orthographic_lower_level
cases.route: RetainedScene set_dynamic_resolution/submit/record_frame_time with the test's own completion callbacks

cases.name: pixel_camera_bypass
cases.route: composed game, authored pixel-perfect camera, disabled control vs stepping policy at 4/16

amendments.reason: fixed_scales_ui_offset_viewport (run 1, 8 attempts, retained) excluded UI widgets and chose opaque control interiors in logical UI coordinates; with a camera viewport the existing UI contract maps the logical UI viewport onto the viewport rect (offset 37.5/21.25, scale 880.25/959 and 495.5/539), so the mapping and interior checks compared UI pixels. Its renderer receipts, 100% byte equality, chrome and UI-state checks are unaffected. The re-check repeats only the 75%/50% frames and references with physical boxes, funded by the 4 unallocated attempts; no other case changes budget.

adaptive_natural_cadence (7 attempts, retained, verdict passed) delivered no completion: over 7 back-to-back ticks (6.3 ms) the host's own non-blocking polls never observed frame 1 complete, so the scale stayed 12/16 without samples. To retain real delivered measurements within the 48-attempt cap: (1) fixed_scales_mapping_recheck (never run) becomes fixed_scales_reference_recheck, 2 attempts, because the appearance run retained the 12/16 and 8/16 frames byte-identically (RGBA hashes equal run 1's receipts); (2) terminal_failures_and_late_callbacks drops its two post-failure accept attempts (no queue work; the regression suite's game.rs already asserts later ticks fail) and keeps 4; (3) adaptive_paced_explicit_dispatch adds 4 attempts with one explicit blocking poll after each tick.
